 Grand Coteau police announce arrest in 2025 shooting that wounded 2 teens 
 By ANF Digital Team Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 6:43 PM CST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google GRAND COTEAU, La. (Acadiana News First) - Grand Coteau police announced the arrest of a suspect in connection with a shooting that wounded two teens nearly a year ago.
 Grand Coteau Police Chief Brad Randell reported Sedrick Woodson was booked on two counts of attempted murder in connection with a shooting that happened on Nov. 23, 2025.
 Sedrick Woodson (CREDIT: St. Landry Parish Sheriff's Office) He explained investigators spent several months gathering evidence and identifying the people responsible for the shooting.
 He added more arrests are expected.
 “The safety and protection of our citizens, particularly our youth, remains the highest priority of this department,” Chief Randell said. “We will continue to exhaust every resource to ensure all individuals involved in this incident are held fully accountable under the law.”
 The investigation is ongoing.
